hindi: मिलकर शत्रु और विजिगीषु के, दो अमित्रों के, दूसरे पर आक्रमण करने वाले दोनों के पार्ष्णि पकड़ने पर, जो शक्तिसम्पन्न का पार्ष्णि पकड़ता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: [When] the enemy and the conqueror, having combined, two enemies, two attackers of the other, are seizing the heel, he who seizes the heel of one endowed with power outwits.
notes: The opening string of dual genitives (saṃhatya-ari-vijigīṣvoḥ amitrayoḥ para-abhiyoginoḥ pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇatoḥ) is rendered literally as a genitive absolute; it is not clear who the two are and whether the relative yaḥ is one of them or a third party. The '-' join of the gerund saṃhatya to the compound is as printed (possible alternatives: saṃhata- 'combined', or the gerund taken with the two). para = 'the other' (glossary 9.2: pare = the others), not 'enemy'. pārṣṇiṃ gṛh = seize the heel (glossary); atisandhatte = outwits (glossary 9.1).
lines_deva: संहत्य-अरि.विजिगीष्वोर् अमित्रयोः पर.अभियोगिनोः पार्ष्णिं गृह्णतोर् यः शक्ति.सम्पन्नस्य पार्ष्णिं गृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: saṃhatya-ari.vijigīṣvor amitrayoḥ para.abhiyoginoḥ pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇator yaḥ śakti.sampannasya pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

hindi: क्योंकि शक्तिसम्पन्न शत्रु का उच्छेद करके पार्ष्णिग्राह का उच्छेद कर सकता है, न हीन शक्ति वाला, लाभ न पाया हुआ।
english: For one endowed with power, having cut off the enemy, can cut off the heel-seizer, not one deficient in power, whose gain is not obtained.
notes: Optative ucchindyāt rendered 'can cut off' (alternative: 'should/would cut off'). The two bahuvrīhi adjectives hīna-śaktiḥ and alabdha-lābhaḥ stand without ca, so they are not joined by 'and'.
lines_deva: शक्ति.सम्पन्नो ह्य् अमित्रम् उच्छिद्य पार्ष्णि.ग्राहम् उच्छिन्द्यात्, न हीन.शक्तिर् अलब्ध.लाभः
lines_iast: śakti.sampanno hy amitram ucchidya pārṣṇi.grāham ucchindyāt, na hīna.śaktir alabdha.lābhaḥ

hindi: शक्ति की समानता में जो विपुल आरम्भ वाले का पार्ष्णि पकड़ता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In equality of power, he who seizes the heel of one of large undertaking outwits.
notes: ārambha = undertaking (literally 'beginning, enterprise').
lines_deva: शक्ति.साम्ये यो विपुल.आरम्भस्य पार्ष्णिं गृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: śakti.sāmye yo vipula.ārambhasya pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

hindi: क्योंकि विपुल आरम्भ वाला शत्रु का उच्छेद करके पार्ष्णिग्राह का उच्छेद कर सकता है, न अल्प आरम्भ वाला, अटके हुए चक्र वाला।
english: For one of large undertaking, having cut off the enemy, can cut off the heel-seizer, not one of small undertaking, with a stuck wheel.
notes: sakta-cakra rendered literally 'with stuck wheel' (sakta = attached, stuck; cakra = wheel); the sense is obscure (a figurative 'wheel' = circle, realm or army is possible); no sense is imported.
lines_deva: विपुल.आरम्भो ह्य् अमित्रम् उच्छिद्य पार्ष्णि.ग्राहम् उच्छिन्द्यात्, न-अल्प.आरम्भः सक्त.चक्रः
lines_iast: vipula.ārambho hy amitram ucchidya pārṣṇi.grāham ucchindyāt, na-alpa.ārambhaḥ sakta.cakraḥ

hindi: आरम्भ की समानता में जो सर्व-समूह के साथ प्रयाण किए हुए का पार्ष्णि पकड़ता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In equality of undertaking, he who seizes the heel of one who has marched with the whole gathering outwits.
notes: sarva-sandoha = the whole gathering (glossary 7.4, literal); what is gathered is not stated and no noun is supplied.
lines_deva: आरम्भ.साम्ये यः सर्व.सन्दोहेन प्रयातस्य पार्ष्णिं गृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: ārambha.sāmye yaḥ sarva.sandohena prayātasya pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

words.gloss: marched with part of the army
who has made provision for the heel

hindi: क्योंकि शून्य मूल वाला इसके लिए सुकर होता है, न एक भाग की सेना के साथ प्रयाण करने वाला, पार्ष्णि का प्रतिविधान किया हुआ।
english: For one whose base is empty becomes easy to do for this one; not one who has marched with part of the army, who has made provision for the heel.
notes: asya taken as 'for this one' (the heel-seizer of the previous unit); sukara = easy to do (literal). eka-deśa-bala = 'army of one part' (part of the army). kṛta-pārṣṇi-pratividhāna = 'by whom provision for the heel has been made'. Reading of the clause is moderately uncertain.
lines_deva: शून्य.मूलो ह्य् अस्य सुकरो भवति, नैक.देश.बल.प्रयातः कृत.पार्ष्णि.प्रतिविधानः
lines_iast: śūnya.mūlo hy asya sukaro bhavati, naika.deśa.bala.prayātaḥ kṛta.pārṣṇi.pratividhānaḥ

words.gloss: in equality of taking up of troops

hindi: सेना को ग्रहण करने की समानता में जो चलते हुए शत्रु पर प्रयाण किए हुए का पार्ष्णि पकड़ता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In equality of taking up of troops, he who seizes the heel of one who has marched on a moving enemy outwits.
notes: cala = moving (opposite sthita, 'standing', units 8-9); 'unsteady' is an alternative. prayāta taken with the accusative as 'marched on'.
lines_deva: बल.उपादान.साम्ये यश् चल.अमित्रं प्रयातस्य पार्ष्णिं गृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: bala.upādāna.sāmye yaś cala.amitraṃ prayātasya pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

hindi: क्योंकि चलते हुए शत्रु पर प्रयाण किया हुआ, सरलता से सफलता पाया हुआ, पार्ष्णिग्राह का उच्छेद कर सकता है, न स्थित शत्रु पर प्रयाण किया हुआ।
english: For one who has marched on a moving enemy, having easily attained success, can cut off the heel-seizer, not one who has marched on a standing enemy.
lines_deva: चल.अमित्रं प्रयातो हि सुखेन-अवाप्त.सिद्धिः पार्ष्णि.ग्राहम् उच्छिन्द्यात्, न स्थित.अमित्रं प्रयातः
lines_iast: cala.amitraṃ prayāto hi sukhena-avāpta.siddhiḥ pārṣṇi.grāham ucchindyāt, na sthita.amitraṃ prayātaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि वह दुर्ग से प्रतिहत और पार्ष्णिग्राह पर लौटा हुआ स्थित शत्रु के द्वारा रोक लिया जाता है।
english: For that one, repulsed by a fort and turned back at the heel-seizer, is restrained by a standing enemy.
notes: pārṣṇi-grāhe (locative) could also be read 'when there is a heel-seizer' (locative absolute); rendered literally 'at'. avagṛhyate = is restrained (glossary 9.2: avagṛhṇīyāt = restrain).
lines_deva: असौ हि दुर्ग.प्रतिहतः पार्ष्णि.ग्राहे च प्रतिनिवृत्तः स्थितेन-अमित्रेण-अवगृह्यते
lines_iast: asau hi durga.pratihataḥ pārṣṇi.grāhe ca pratinivṛttaḥ sthitena-amitreṇa-avagṛhyate

hindi: इससे पूर्व वालों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the earlier [ones] are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ' (glossary 4.1/3.6); pūrve is an unnamed plural, 'ones' supplied in brackets in English only (it refers back to the earlier cases, units 3-9).
lines_deva: तेन पूर्वे व्याख्याताः
lines_iast: tena pūrve vyākhyātāḥ

hindi: शत्रु की समानता में जो धार्मिक आक्रमणकारी का पार्ष्णि पकड़ता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In equality of enemy, he who seizes the heel of a righteous attacker outwits.
notes: śatru-sāmya = sameness of enemy (the enemy being the same), rendered literally 'equality of enemy'. abhiyogin = attacker (cf. glossary abhiyoktṛ).
lines_deva: शत्रु.साम्ये यो धार्मिक.अभियोगिनः पार्ष्णिं गृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: śatru.sāmye yo dhārmika.abhiyoginaḥ pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

hindi: क्योंकि धार्मिक आक्रमणकारी अपनों और दूसरों के लिए द्वेष्य होता है, अधार्मिक आक्रमणकारी सम्प्रिय है।
english: For a righteous attacker becomes hateful to one's own and to the others; an unrighteous attacker [is] well-loved.
notes: Rendered literally; the statement is as printed. sveṣām/pareṣām taken as datives of interest ('to'); the predicate of the second clause is a bare copula.
lines_deva: धार्मिक.अभियोगी हि स्वेषां परेषां च द्वेष्यो भवति, अधार्मिक.अभियोगी सम्प्रियः
lines_iast: dhārmika.abhiyogī hi sveṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca dveṣyo bhavati, adhārmika.abhiyogī sampriyaḥ

words.gloss: of attackers: taker of the base, one of the immediate, miser

hindi: इससे मूल हरने वाले, तात्कालिक, कंजूस आक्रमणकारियों के पार्ष्णि पकड़ने की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the seizing of the heel of attackers who are takers of the base, [those] of the immediate, misers is explained.
notes: mūla-hara = taker of the base (glossary 7.2); tādātvika = of the immediate (from tadātva, glossary 9.4); kadarya = miser (standard sense). The three are taken as kinds of attacker; the Hindi list has commas only (three members). Which kinds of attacker these are is not explained in the text.
lines_deva: तेन मूल.हर.तादात्विक.कदर्य.अभियोगिनां पार्ष्णि.ग्रहणं व्याख्यातम्
lines_iast: tena mūla.hara.tādātvika.kadarya.abhiyogināṃ pārṣṇi.grahaṇaṃ vyākhyātam

words.gloss: of the two attackers of an ally
in the seizing of the heel

hindi: मित्र पर आक्रमण करने वाले दोनों के पार्ष्णि पकड़ने में वे ही कारण हैं।
english: In the seizing of the heel of the two attackers of an ally, those alone [are] the reasons.
notes: mitra-abhiyoginoḥ taken as 'two attackers of an ally' (as in unit 15 mitra-abhiyoginaḥ); an alternative is the dvandva 'of the ally and the attacker'. 'Those' = the reasons given above (the earlier units).
lines_deva: मित्र.अभियोगिनोः पार्ष्णि.ग्रहणे त एव हेतवः
lines_iast: mitra.abhiyoginoḥ pārṣṇi.grahaṇe ta eva hetavaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. mid. abhi-√yuj m. gen. du.

words.gloss: of the attacker of an ally

hindi: मित्र और शत्रु पर आक्रमण करने वाले दोनों में जो मित्र पर आक्रमण करने वाले का पार्ष्णि पकड़ता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: Of the two attacking an ally and an enemy, he who seizes the heel of the attacker of an ally outwits.
notes: The genitive dual is taken partitively ('of the two'); the alternative is a genitive absolute ('when two attack ...').
lines_deva: मित्रम् अमित्रं च-अभियुञ्जानयोर् यो मित्र.अभियोगिनः पार्ष्णिं गृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: mitram amitraṃ ca-abhiyuñjānayor yo mitra.abhiyoginaḥ pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

hindi: क्योंकि मित्र पर आक्रमण करने वाला, सरलता से सफलता पाया हुआ, पार्ष्णिग्राह का उच्छेद कर सकता है।
english: For the attacker of an ally, having easily attained success, can cut off the heel-seizer.
lines_deva: मित्र.अभियोगी हि सुखेन-अवाप्त.सिद्धिः पार्ष्णि.ग्राहम् उच्छिन्द्यात्
lines_iast: mitra.abhiyogī hi sukhena-avāpta.siddhiḥ pārṣṇi.grāham ucchindyāt

hindi: क्योंकि मित्र के साथ सन्धि सुकर है, शत्रु के साथ नहीं।
english: For peace with an ally [is] easy to do, not with an enemy.
notes: sandhi = peace (bare sandhi, glossary 7.3/7.4/7.5); 'treaty' (glossary 7.7) is the alternative.
lines_deva: सुकरो हि मित्रेण सन्धिर् न-अमित्रेण
lines_iast: sukaro hi mitreṇa sandhir na-amitreṇa

words.gram: pres. part. ud-√hṛ m. gen. du.

words.gloss: of the one lifting out an enemy

hindi: मित्र और शत्रु को निकालने वाले दोनों में जो शत्रु को निकालने वाले का पार्ष्णि पकड़ता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: Of the two lifting out an ally and an enemy, he who seizes the heel of the one lifting out an enemy outwits.
notes: ud-√hṛ rendered literally 'lift out' (for an ally perhaps 'rescue', for an enemy perhaps 'uproot'); the one verb covers both objects. The genitive dual is taken partitively.
lines_deva: मित्रम् अमित्रं च-उद्धरतोर् यो ऽमित्र.उद्धारिणः पार्ष्णिं गृह्णाति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: mitram amitraṃ ca-uddharator yo 'mitra.uddhāriṇaḥ pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇāti so 'tisandhatte

hindi: क्योंकि बढ़े हुए मित्र वाला, शत्रु को निकालने वाला, पार्ष्णिग्राह का उच्छेद कर सकता है, न दूसरा, अपने पक्ष को क्षति पहुँचाने वाला।
english: For one with a grown ally, lifting out an enemy, can cut off the heel-seizer, not the other, injuring his own side.
notes: vṛddha = grown (not 'old'); 'the other' (itaraḥ) is the one who lifts out an ally (previous unit). pakṣa = side (party).
lines_deva: वृद्ध.मित्रो ह्य् अमित्र.उद्धारी पार्ष्णि.ग्राहम् उच्छिन्द्यात्, न-इतरः स्व.पक्ष.उपघाती
lines_iast: vṛddha.mitro hy amitra.uddhārī pārṣṇi.grāham ucchindyāt, na-itaraḥ sva.pakṣa.upaghātī

words.gloss: on going away with gain not obtained
with an excess of loss and expenditure

hindi: उन दोनों में, लाभ न पाए हुए चले जाने पर, जिसका शत्रु बड़े लाभ से वियुक्त है अथवा क्षय और व्यय में अधिक है, वह पार्ष्णिग्राह छल लेता है।
english: Of those two, on going away with gain not obtained, that heel-seizer outwits whose enemy is separated from great gain or has an excess of loss and expenditure.

text_flags.why: possible: yasya is an inflected pronoun and a separate word; a '.' compound join is wrong here (unit 21 has 'yasya-amitro')

notes: 'yasya.amitro' is printed with '.', but yasya is a separate word (compare unit 21 'yasya-amitro'), so two entries are given. apagamana = going away (literal). kṣaya = loss, vyaya = expenditure, lābha = gain (glossary 9.4).
lines_deva: तयोर् अलब्ध.लाभ.अपगमने यस्य.अमित्रो महतो लाभाद् वियुक्तः क्षय.व्यय.अधिको वा स पार्ष्णि.ग्राहो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: tayor alabdha.lābha.apagamane yasya.amitro mahato lābhād viyuktaḥ kṣaya.vyaya.adhiko vā sa pārṣṇi.grāho 'tisandhatte

words.gloss: on going away with gain obtained
of the enemy, to the enemy

hindi: लाभ पाकर चले जाने पर जिसका शत्रु लाभ से, शक्ति से हीन है, वह पार्ष्णिग्राह छल लेता है, अथवा जिसका जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है, शत्रु के विग्रह और अपकार में समर्थ हो।
english: On going away with gain obtained, that heel-seizer outwits whose enemy is deficient in gain, in power, or [he] whose one to be marched against would be capable of war and injury to the enemy.
notes: The last clause is elliptical (the main verb is not repeated); śatroḥ is taken as the objective genitive 'to the enemy' (alternative: 'of the enemy'). vigraha = war, apakāra = injury (glossary 7.1). The two instrumentals lābhena śaktyā stand without ca.
lines_deva: लब्ध.लाभ.अपगमने यस्य-अमित्रो लाभेन शक्त्या हीनः स पार्ष्णि.ग्राहो ऽतिसन्धत्ते, यस्य वा यातव्यः शत्रोर् विग्रह.अपकार.समर्थः स्यात्
lines_iast: labdha.lābha.apagamane yasya-amitro lābhena śaktyā hīnaḥ sa pārṣṇi.grāho 'tisandhatte, yasya vā yātavyaḥ śatror vigraha.apakāra.samarthaḥ syāt

words.gloss: superior in feasible undertaking and taking up of troops

hindi: दोनों पार्ष्णिग्राहों में भी जो शक्य आरम्भ और सेना को ग्रहण करने में अधिक है, स्थित शत्रु अथवा पार्श्व में स्थित रहने वाला, वह छल लेता है।
english: Of the two heel-seizers also, he who is superior in feasible undertaking and taking up of troops, a standing enemy or a flank-stander, outwits.
notes: sthita-śatru is taken as a class of heel-seizer ('standing enemy'); the alternative is the bahuvrīhi 'one whose enemy is standing'. śakya-ārambha = feasible (possible) undertaking. bala-upādāna = taking up troops (glossary 9.2).
lines_deva: पार्ष्णि.ग्राहयोर् अपि यः शक्य.आरम्भ.बल.उपादान.अधिकः स्थित.शत्रुः पार्श्व.स्थायी वा सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: pārṣṇi.grāhayor api yaḥ śakya.ārambha.bala.upādāna.adhikaḥ sthita.śatruḥ pārśva.sthāyī vā so 'tisandhatte

words.gloss: reinforcement of the one to be marched against

hindi: क्योंकि पार्श्व में स्थित रहने वाला जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है उसकी सहायता और मूल का बाधक होता है, मूल का बाधक ही पीछे स्थित रहने वाला है।
english: For a flank-stander becomes a reinforcement of the one to be marched against and a harasser of the base; just a harasser of the base [is] a rear-stander.
notes: abhisāra = reinforcement (glossary 8.5); alternative 'assault'. The last clause is verbless; word order allows 'the rear-stander is only a harasser of the base' (taken so in sense) or 'only a harasser of the base is a rear-stander'. ābādhaka = harassing, hindering.
lines_deva: पार्श्व.स्थायी हि यातव्य.अभिसारो मूल.आबाधकश् च भवति, मूल.आबाधक एव पश्चात्.स्थायी
lines_iast: pārśva.sthāyī hi yātavya.abhisāro mūla.ābādhakaś ca bhavati, mūla.ābādhaka eva paścāt.sthāyī

hindi: शत्रु की चेष्टा को रोकने वाले तीन पार्ष्णिग्राह जानने योग्य हैं: पीछे सामन्त, वर्ग और दोनों पार्श्वों में दो पड़ोसी।
english: Three heel-seizers are to be known, obstructors of the enemy's activity: the neighbouring chief at the back, the group, and the two neighbours on the two flanks.
notes: The text says three, but names a neighbouring chief, a 'group' (varga, left literal) and two flank neighbours; how these make three kinds is not stated (varga may be a class of its own). Hindi list has commas except the final ca.
lines_deva: पार्ष्णि.ग्राहास् त्रयो ज्ञेयाः शत्रोश् चेष्टा.निरोधकाः
सामन्तः पृष्ठतो वर्गः प्रतिवेशौ च पार्श्वयोः
lines_iast: pārṣṇi.grāhās trayo jñeyāḥ śatroś ceṣṭā.nirodhakāḥ
sāmantaḥ pṛṣṭhato vargaḥ prativeśau ca pārśvayoḥ

words.gloss: having fort, forest and place of retreat

hindi: शत्रु और नेता के मध्य में स्थित दुर्बल अन्तर्धि कहा जाता है; बलवान् का प्रतिघात दुर्ग, वन, अपसार वाला है।
english: A weak one standing in the middle of the enemy and the leader is called antardhi; the repulse of the strong [is] possessing fort, forest and a place of retreat.
notes: antardhi kept untranslated (glossary 7.2). netṛ = leader (here the conqueror, as unit 37-38). Line b is verbless: pratighāta may be a second technical name defined as 'the strong one having fort, forest and retreat' (supplied copula in brackets in English), or 'repulse of the strong'; sense uncertain. apasāra = place of retreat (glossary 10.2). aṭavī in the list = forest (a place).
lines_deva: अरेर् नेतुश् च मध्यस्थो दुर्बलो ऽन्तर्धिर् उच्यते
प्रतिघातो बलवतो दुर्ग.अटव्य्.अपसारवान्
lines_iast: arer netuś ca madhyastho durbalo 'ntardhir ucyate
pratighāto balavato durga.aṭavy.apasāravān

words.gram: desid. pres. part. √labh m. gen. du.

words.gloss: on going away with gain obtained

hindi: किन्तु शत्रु और विजिगीषु दोनों के, मध्यम को पाना चाहते हुए, मध्यम का पार्ष्णि पकड़ने पर, लाभ पाकर चले जाने पर, जो मध्यम को मित्र से अलग करता है और शत्रु को, मित्र को प्राप्त करता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: But, of the enemy and the conqueror, [both] wishing to obtain the middle king, [as the two are] seizing the heel of the middle king, on going away with gain obtained, he who separates the middle king from an ally and obtains the enemy [as] an ally outwits.
notes: Last clause 'amitraṃ ca mitram āpnoti' is ambiguous (the position of ca; 'obtains the enemy as an ally' is supplied in brackets in English; alternative 'obtains an enemy and an ally'); the Hindi 'के रूप में' follows the English supply. The genitive duals are taken as absolute. tu = but (किन्तु); madhyama = the middle king (glossary 6.2). Hindi leaves the two accusatives (amitraṃ, mitram) unlinked, with no 'के रूप में', since Hindi cannot bracket a supplied 'as'.
lines_deva: मध्यमं त्वरि.विजिगीष्वोर् लिप्समानयोर् मध्यमस्य पार्ष्णिं गृह्णतोर् लब्ध.लाभ.अपगमने यो मध्यमं मित्राद् वियोजयत्य् अमित्रं च मित्रम् आप्नोति सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: madhyamaṃ tvari.vijigīṣvor lipsamānayor madhyamasya pārṣṇiṃ gṛhṇator labdha.lābha.apagamane yo madhyamaṃ mitrād viyojayaty amitraṃ ca mitram āpnoti so 'tisandhatte

words.gram: pres. part. mid. upa-√kṛ m. nom. sg.

words.gloss: from the state of an ally

hindi: और उपकार करता हुआ शत्रु सन्धि करने योग्य है, न मित्रभाव से निकला हुआ मित्र।
english: And an enemy who does a favour is one to be allied with, not an ally who has departed from the state of ally.
notes: sandheya = one with whom peace is to be made (sandhi = peace, glossary 7.3; 'treaty' is the alternative); upakurvāṇa = doing a favour (helping). utkrānta = gone out, departed (alternative 'transgressed'). Rendered 'to be allied with' per glossary 7.6 (sandheya/asandheya); 'one with whom peace is to be made' is the literal alternative.
lines_deva: सन्धेयश् च शत्रुर् उपकुर्वाणो, न मित्रं मित्र.भावाद् उत्क्रान्तम्
lines_iast: sandheyaś ca śatrur upakurvāṇo, na mitraṃ mitra.bhāvād utkrāntam

words.gloss: wish to obtain the neutral king

hindi: इससे उदासीन को प्राप्त करने की इच्छा की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the wish to obtain the neutral king is explained.
notes: lipsā = wish to obtain (desiderative of labh); udāsīna = the neutral king (glossary 6.2).
lines_deva: तेन-उदासीन.लिप्सा व्याख्याता
lines_iast: tena-udāsīna.lipsā vyākhyātā

words.gloss: in seizing the heel and marching against

hindi: “किन्तु पार्ष्णि पकड़ने और अभियान में मन्त्रयुद्ध से संचय है
english: “But in [the case of] seizing the heel and marching against, [there is] a heaping up from war of counsel
notes: The quotation of the teachers opens here and closes at unit 31 (not flagged). abhyuccaya = heaping up (glossary 7.1, literal; alternatives: increase, advantage, superiority); the locative/genitive dual is taken as 'in [the case of]'. mantra-yuddha = war of counsel (glossary 12.1). abhiyāna = marching against.
lines_deva: "पार्ष्णि.ग्रहण.अभियानयोस् तु मन्त्र.युद्धाद् अभ्युच्चयः
lines_iast: "pārṣṇi.grahaṇa.abhiyānayos tu mantra.yuddhād abhyuccayaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि व्यायाम-युद्ध में क्षय और व्यय से दोनों की वृद्धि नहीं है।
english: For in war of exertion, by loss and expenditure, [there is] no growth of both.
notes: vyāyāma = exertion (as in Book 10 fighting; the 6.2 sense 'activity' is the alternative); the unit continues the quotation opened in unit 29.
lines_deva: व्यायाम.युद्धे हि क्षय.व्ययाभ्याम् उभयोर् अवृद्धिः
lines_iast: vyāyāma.yuddhe hi kṣaya.vyayābhyām ubhayor avṛddhiḥ

hindi: क्योंकि जीतकर भी क्षीण सेना और कोश वाला पराजित होता है,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: For even having conquered, one with diminished army and treasury becomes defeated,” say the teachers.

text_flags.why: possible: short i for long ī (kṣīṇa 'diminished')

notes: Closes the quotation opened in unit 29. daṇḍa = army (as a constituent element, glossary 12.1). kṣīṇa = diminished (glossary 7.5). Printed kṣiṇa is probably kṣīṇa.
lines_deva: जित्वा-अपि हि क्षिण.दण्ड.कोशः पराजितो भवति" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: jitvā-api hi kṣiṇa.daṇḍa.kośaḥ parājito bhavati" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.
notes: Formula 'na iti kauṭilyaḥ' (glossary 12.1).
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-iti kauṭilyaḥ

hindi: बहुत बड़े क्षय और व्यय से भी शत्रु का विनाश स्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए।
english: Even by a very great loss and expenditure, the destruction of the enemy is to be accepted.
notes: abhyupa-√gam = approach, accept, undertake (alternative 'undertaken').
lines_deva: सुमहता-अपि क्षय.व्ययेन शत्रु.विनाशो ऽभ्युपगन्तव्यः
lines_iast: sumahatā-api kṣaya.vyayena śatru.vināśo 'bhyupagantavyaḥ

hindi: समान क्षय और व्यय में जो पहले दूष्य सेना को मरवाकर, काँटे से रहित, बाद में वश में सेना वाला युद्ध करे, वह छल लेता है।
english: In equal loss and expenditure, he who, having first had the treasonable army killed, free of the thorn, would afterwards fight with an obedient army, outwits.
notes: dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary 6.2); śalya = thorn (dart), taken figuratively as nothing is said. vaśya = obedient, under control. Printed nihśalyaḥ is the e-text's regular h for visarga before a sibilant (glossary 7.10); w reads niḥśalyaḥ, no flag.
lines_deva: तुल्ये क्षय.व्यये यः पुरस्ताद् दूष्य.बलं घातयित्वा निह्शल्यः पश्चाद् वश्य.बलो युध्येत सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: tulye kṣaya.vyaye yaḥ purastād dūṣya.balaṃ ghātayitvā nihśalyaḥ paścād vaśya.balo yudhyeta so 'tisandhatte

hindi: पहले दूष्य सेना को मारने वाले दोनों में भी जो अधिक प्रचुर, अधिक शक्तिमान् और अत्यन्त दूष्य को मरवाए, वह छल लेता है।
english: Of the two who first kill the treasonable army also, he who should cause the more abundant, the more powerful and the utterly treasonable to be killed outwits.
notes: The objects of ghātayet are unnamed (army or persons); no noun is supplied. bahulatara = more abundant (numerous).
lines_deva: द्वयोर् अपि पुरस्ताद् दूष्य.बल.घातिनोर् यो बहुलतरं शक्तिमत्तरम् अत्यन्त.दूष्यं च घातयेत् सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: dvayor api purastād dūṣya.bala.ghātinor yo bahulataraṃ śaktimattaram atyanta.dūṣyaṃ ca ghātayet so 'tisandhatte

words.gloss: killing of enemy troops and forest-tribe troops

hindi: इससे शत्रु और वन-जातियों की सेना को मारने की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the killing of the troops of the enemy and of the forest tribes is explained.
notes: Compound read as amitra-bala and aṭavī-bala sharing ghāta (glossary 9.2: enemy troops, forest-tribe troops).
lines_deva: तेन-अमित्र.अटवी.बल.घातो व्याख्यातः
lines_iast: tena-amitra.aṭavī.bala.ghāto vyākhyātaḥ

hindi: जब पार्ष्णिग्राह, या आक्रमणकारी, या जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है, हो, तब वहाँ विजिगीषु इस नेत्र का आचरण करे।
english: When [he] should be a heel-seizer, or an attacker, or one to be marched against, then there the conqueror should follow this netra ('guide', literally 'eye').
notes: The subject of bhavet is understood to be the conqueror. netra is left as the term with its literal sense ('eye', that which leads); the meaning is uncertain (alternatives: 'guide', 'rule of conduct'). The two vā are rendered 'or ... or'.
lines_deva: पार्ष्णि.ग्राहो ऽभियोक्ता वा यातव्यो वा यदा भवेत्
विजिगीषुस् तदा तत्र नेत्रम् एतत् समाचरेत्
lines_iast: pārṣṇi.grāho 'bhiyoktā vā yātavyo vā yadā bhavet
vijigīṣus tadā tatra netram etat samācaret

words.gloss: with the reinforcer of the heel-seizer

hindi: नेता मित्र पर आक्रमण करने वाले शत्रु का पार्ष्णिग्राह बने, पहले आक्रन्द को पार्ष्णिग्राह की सहायता करने वाले के साथ विग्रह में लगाकर।
english: The leader should be the heel-seizer of the enemy who is an attacker of an ally, having first set the rear ally at war with the reinforcer of the heel-seizer.
notes: netā = leader (the conqueror, as in unit 25). vigrāhya taken as the gerund of the causative of vi-√grah (vigraha = war; cf. glossary 7.4 vigṛhya = having made war); the construction (who is set at war with whom) is uncertain. abhisārin = one who reinforces (abhisāra = reinforcement, glossary 8.5).
lines_deva: पार्ष्णि.ग्राहो भवेन् नेता शत्रोर् मित्र.अभियोगिनः
विग्राह्य पूर्वम् आक्रन्दं पार्ष्णि.ग्राह.अभिसारिणा
lines_iast: pārṣṇi.grāho bhaven netā śatror mitra.abhiyoginaḥ
vigrāhya pūrvam ākrandaṃ pārṣṇi.grāha.abhisāriṇā

words.gram: pres. part. mid. abhi-√yuj m. nom. sg.

words.gloss: with the reinforcement of the rear ally

hindi: आक्रन्द के साथ आक्रमण करता हुआ पार्ष्णिग्राह का निवारण करे; उसी प्रकार आक्रन्द की सहायता से पार्ष्णिग्राह की सहायता करने वाले का निवारण करे।
english: Attacking with the rear ally, he should keep off the heel-seizer; likewise, with the reinforcement of the rear ally, [he should keep off] the reinforcer of the heel-seizer.
notes: Line b has no verb; nivārayet is carried over (bracketed in English, supplied plainly in Hindi). nivārayet = keep off (literal: cause to turn back).
lines_deva: आक्रन्देन-अभियुञ्जानः पार्ष्णि.ग्राहं निवारयेत्
तथा-आक्रन्द.अभिसारेण पार्ष्णि.ग्राह.अभिसारिणम्
lines_iast: ākrandena-abhiyuñjānaḥ pārṣṇi.grāhaṃ nivārayet
tathā-ākranda.abhisāreṇa pārṣṇi.grāha.abhisāriṇam

hindi: और शत्रु के मित्र से मित्र को सामने टकराए; मित्र के मित्र को, और शत्रु के भी, मित्र के मित्र से निवारण करे।
english: And with the enemy's ally he should jostle the ally in front; the ally's ally, and also of the enemy, he should keep off with the ally's ally.
notes: Obscure. avaghaṭṭayet is literally 'cause to rub against, jostle'; rendered 'obstruct'. ari-mitra = ally of the enemy (alternative: some other relation); the object in line a is simply 'ally' (whose ally is not stated). Line b is elliptical ('and of the enemy also' = the enemy's ally's ally); read as given, with ca and api both rendered. 'obstruct' withdrawn at review: avaghaṭṭayet is kept literal ('jostle'); the actual sense is unsettled. The '.' joins in ari.mitreṇa and mitra.mitram(-eṇa) are genuine compounds (enemy's ally, ally's ally), one w entry each: checked, correct.
lines_deva: अरि.मित्रेण मित्रं च पुरस्ताद् अवघट्टयेत्
मित्र.मित्रम् अरेश् च-अपि मित्र.मित्रेण वारयेत्
lines_iast: ari.mitreṇa mitraṃ ca purastād avaghaṭṭayet
mitra.mitram areś ca-api mitra.mitreṇa vārayet

hindi: जिस पर आक्रमण किया गया, आक्रमणकारी का पार्ष्णि मित्र के द्वारा पकड़वाए; और मित्र के मित्र के द्वारा आक्रन्द, पार्ष्णिग्राहों का निवारण करे।
english: Attacked, [he] should have the heel of the attacker seized through an ally; and through the ally's ally he should keep off the rear ally, the heel-seizers.
notes: abhiyuktaḥ is read as 'being attacked' with the subject (the one attacked) understood; the object pair ākrandaṃ pārṣṇi-grāhān has no ca between the two, so it is kept as a bare apposition/list. grāhayet = cause to be seized (glossary 9.6).
lines_deva: मित्रेण ग्राहयेत् पार्ष्णिम् अभियुक्तो ऽभियोगिनः
मित्र.मित्रेण च-आक्रन्दं पार्ष्णि.ग्राहान् निवारयेत्
lines_iast: mitreṇa grāhayet pārṣṇim abhiyukto 'bhiyoginaḥ
mitra.mitreṇa ca-ākrandaṃ pārṣṇi.grāhān nivārayet

words.gloss: with the excellence of the ally constituent element

hindi: इस प्रकार विजिगीषु स्वयं के लिए मण्डल की स्थापना करे, पीछे और आगे, मित्र प्रकृति की सम्पत् से।
english: In this way the conqueror should establish the circle for himself, both at the back and in front, with the excellence of the ally constituent element.
notes: ātma-artham = for himself (literally 'for the self's purpose'). niveśayet = cause to settle, establish (niveśa = encampment, glossary 10.4). mitra-prakṛti-sampad: prakṛti = constituent element, sampat = excellence (glossary 6.1); read as 'ally-prakṛti', alternative 'allies and constituent elements'.
lines_deva: एवं मण्डलम् आत्म.अर्थं विजिगीषुर् निवेशयेत्
पृष्ठतश् च पुरस्ताच् च मित्र.प्रकृति.सम्पदा
lines_iast: evaṃ maṇḍalam ātma.arthaṃ vijigīṣur niveśayet
pṛṣṭhataś ca purastāc ca mitra.prakṛti.sampadā

hindi: और सम्पूर्ण मण्डल में सदा दूतों और गुप्तचरों को बसाए; प्रतिद्वन्द्वियों का मित्र बना हुआ और बार-बार मारकर छिपा हुआ।
english: And in the entire circle he should constantly lodge envoys and secret agents, [himself] having become an ally of the rivals and, having killed again and again, concealed.
notes: Line b is read as describing the conqueror ('[himself]' bracketed); sapatnānām could go with mitra-bhūtaḥ (ally of the rivals) or with hatvā (having killed the rivals). saṃvṛta = concealed (alternative: guarded). sapatna = rival. Repeated hatvā hatvā = 'again and again'.
lines_deva: कृत्स्ने च मण्डले नित्यं दूतान् गूढांश् च वासयेत्
मित्र.भूतः सपत्नानां हत्वा हत्वा च संवृतः
lines_iast: kṛtsne ca maṇḍale nityaṃ dūtān gūḍhāṃś ca vāsayet
mitra.bhūtaḥ sapatnānāṃ hatvā hatvā ca saṃvṛtaḥ

hindi: असंवृत के कार्य, प्राप्त हुए भी, विशेष रूप से निःसन्देह नष्ट हो जाते हैं, समुद्र में टूटी नाव के समान।
english: The tasks of one who is unconcealed, even when attained, especially, come to ruin without doubt, like a broken boat in the ocean.
notes: asaṃvṛta = unconcealed (alternative: unguarded). vipadyante = come to ruin (literally 'fall into misfortune'). Printed nihsaṃśayaṃ is the e-text's regular h for visarga before a sibilant (glossary 7.10); w reads niḥsaṃśayam, no flag.
lines_deva: असंवृतस्य कार्याणि प्राप्तान्य् अपि विशेषतः
निह्संशयं विपद्यन्ते भिन्न.प्लव इव-उदधौ
lines_iast: asaṃvṛtasya kāryāṇi prāptāny api viśeṣataḥ
nihsaṃśayaṃ vipadyante bhinna.plava iva-udadhau
